reuse.why: Builds on the existing shared link guard that every handler (directly or via linkBankSyncAccount) already calls, and extracts unlinkAccount's reset into clearAccountBankLink so both paths use it.

duplication.why: The account reset is moved into one helper used by unlinkAccount and the replacement path; the flag is only threaded through, no logic is copied.

placement.why: The takeover lives in the shared guard in accounts/app.ts, the reset helper sits next to unlinkAccount, and the flag is on LinkAccountBaseParams with the other link options.

scope.why: Only the flag, the guard, the extracted helper and tests.

maintainability.why: Renaming the guard to claimBankAccount honestly reflects that it now mutates, the closed-account check still runs before any change, and one reset definition serves both unlink paths.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link handlers route the flag through claimBankAccount; the reset reuses the extracted clearAccountBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: Existing reset block was extracted, not copied.
